profile: Bright Memory: Infinite Android v1.34 - Minimal Experimental

settings.label: Resolution Controller
settings.integration: Use the game's existing GameUserSettings resolution-scale path; preserve panel resolution, aspect ratio, orientation and Android DPI.
settings.status: runtime path identified in libUE4.so; UI and runtime binding still require engine integration and device validation

settings.label: Graphics Quality
settings.integration: Map each tier to actual supported UE4 scalability and mobile CVars for shadows, view distance, effects, textures, foliage, shading and post-processing. Extreme must only raise settings proven supported by this build.
settings.status: existing runtime profile source needs wiring into the game's actual settings UI and visual validation; do not expose inert labels

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.integration: Qualcomm SGSR1 UE4.27 plugin and shader pass in the game's actual renderer.
settings.status: source vendored; registration and Android shader compilation in shipped renderer are not yet verified

settings.label: Upscale Sharpness
settings.status: must bind to the real SGSR1 shader parameter

settings.label: Upscale Preset
settings.status: must map to SGSR1-supported render fractions and parameters; do not add a second independent render-scale control

settings.label: AMD CAS
settings.status: unavailable until a real CAS RDG shader pass is registered after SGSR1

settings.label: CAS Sharpness
settings.status: bind only to the real CAS pass; disabled while CAS backend is unavailable

status.Off: leave the game's default scheduling unchanged
status.On: use only the verified UE4 one-frame-thread-lag control
status.Ultra: unavailable until a safe queue-depth control is proven for the active Android RHI

settings.label: Frame Generation

status.Off: available; original game presentation path remains active
status.x2: Qualcomm AFME 1.0 path; only enable after runtime confirms GL_QCOM_frame_extrapolation and the game renderer integration is registered

requirements: two GPU color textures and one extrapolated output texture
OpenGL ES context exposing GL_QCOM_frame_extrapolation and glExtrapolateTex2DQCOM
UI composition and motion/occlusion artifact validation

qualcomm_research.Adreno_Neural_Fusion: real Qualcomm FG, but current public SDK requires Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 or newer, Vulkan, and its Unreal plugin targets UE5; not compatible with this Adreno 610 UE4.27 target
qualcomm_research.Adreno_Frame_Motion_Engine_AFME: older Qualcomm OpenGL ES frame extrapolation extension; now selected as the experimental x2 candidate, but Adreno 610 driver support and UE4.27 renderer integration remain unverified
qualcomm_research.decision: do not label any unsupported Qualcomm path as available; continue checking for a genuinely older public Qualcomm FG implementation that supports Adreno 6xx and UE4.27

requirements: two GPU color textures and one extrapolated output texture
OpenGL ES context with Qualcomm extension
qualcomm_afme.runtime_status: sample source verified; Adreno 610 support and integration into Bright Memory UE4.27 renderer not yet verified

safety_rules: never show an option as working when its backend is not registered and validated
do not substitute tonemapper sharpening for AMD CAS
do not fake frame generation by repeating or blending identical frames
keep the original game rendering path as fallback
resolution and graphics quality changes must affect actual game rendering, not only menu text
build_status: settings schema updated; not a compiled APK; AFME runtime integration and UMG menu wiring remain unverified
